_title: Hotels Pay 30% to Book Their Own Rooms
_note: EP006 FINAL, 2026-08-16. `graphic` archetype, as it should have been from the start: a miniature independent hotel standing in an open palm against a blurred street of full-size hotels. Same format as EP001 and a different subject, which is what V6 asks for -- boutique hotel and Mediterranean street rather than glass tower and business park. Chosen over three documentary attempts (Booking.com key, key handover, overhead flatlay) because a scale collision is the only composition tested that reads in ONE glance at 120px. STACK MARKS TRIED THREE WAYS AND DROPPED: as paper chips, as a row along the counter, and scattered across the palm. In every case google's G survived, resend's R read as a letter stamped on skin, and n8n and claude vanished. Four small marks cannot hold at browse width beside a dominant subject and a headline -- the stack belongs on the blueprint cover and the end card, read at arm's length.
